scope: Three unitary light flavours per sector; SM weak-scale quark normalization, registered weak-scale transport of neutrino spectra and angles. One Hermitian family exchange identified up to labelled port permutation, legal rephasings, independently positive diagonal gain on each side and arbitrary real diagonal self-energies. For robustness also allow conjugation and a global sign. Both measured charged-angle branches included. No oscillation appearance phase input.
